name: Sentences
description:
1. SIMPLE SENTENCE
⇒ S + V
⇒ I (Independent)
E.g. : I have a watch.
* Sentence - 1
  Clause - 1
→ Independent Clause
→ Main Clause
→ Principal Clause
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. COMPOUND SENTENCE
⇒ I + I
⇒ Independent + Independent
E.g. : I went to school and my brother stayed at home.
* Sentence - 1
  Clause - 2
1st Clause → Independent Clause
2nd Clause → Independent Clause
→ Joined by Coordinating Conjunction
(and, but, or, so, for, yet, nor)
→ Both clauses are Main / Principal Clauses
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. COMPLEX SENTENCE
⇒ I + D
⇒ Independent + Dependent
E.g. : I know that he is honest.
* Sentence - 1
  Clause - 2
1st Clause → Independent Clause
2nd Clause → Dependent Clause
→ One Main / Principal Clause
→ One Subordinate Clause
Subordinate Clauses :
1. Noun Clause
2. Adjective Clause
3. Adverb Clause
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. COMPOUND-COMPLEX SENTENCE
⇒ I + I + D
⇒ Independent + Independent + Dependent
E.g. : I went to school and my friend stayed home because he was ill.
* Sentence - 1
  Clause - 3
1st Clause → Independent Clause
2nd Clause → Independent Clause
3rd Clause → Dependent Clause
→ Two Main / Principal Clauses
→ One Subordinate Clause
